name: @trycua/pi-durable
description: Cua Spaces as the execution environment of Pi Durable: idempotent, fenced commands and checkpoints that keep the sandbox consistent with the conversation log across crashes

scripts.test:crash:checkpoint: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=checkpoint node test/crash/run.mjs
scripts.test:crash:transactional: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=transactional node test/crash/run.mjs
scripts.test:crash:auto: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=auto node test/crash/run.mjs
scripts.test:crash:stale: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=stale node test/crash/run.mjs
scripts.test:crash:redrive: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=redrive node test/crash/run.mjs
scripts.test:crash:acp: npm run build && CRASH_MODE=acp node test/crash/run.mjs
